en: Sepia-toned portrait of a seated woman in elaborate traditional dress, likely from North Africa or the Middle East. She wears layered garments, a richly decorated headscarf with a veil, heavy jewelry including large earrings, necklaces and chains, and holds what appears to be a pair of scissors or metal implements in her hands. The photo is bordered by a cream card typical of early photographic postcards. No text is visible on the front.
